name: ABC Juice (Apple, Beetroot, Carrot)
benefits: Brings together beta-carotene from carrot, nitrates from beetroot and the sweetness of apple
A friendlier taste for people who find plain beetroot juice too earthy
Gives vitamin A, folate and potassium in one glass
caution: Apple adds natural sugar; keep it to one small glass
Same cautions as beetroot juice for kidney stones and blood pressure medicines

en: Wash and chop the apple, beetroot and carrot.
Blend with water till smooth.
Strain, add lemon and drink fresh.
hi: सेब, चुकंदर और गाजर धोकर काट लें।
पानी के साथ चिकना पीस लें।
छान लें, नींबू डालें और ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Green Juice (Palak, Kheera, Pudina)
benefits: Spinach gives folate, vitamin K and some iron
Cucumber and mint make it light and fresh
Much less sugar than fruit juices
caution: If you take blood thinners like warfarin, keep the amount of greens steady and ask your doctor
Spinach is high in oxalates; if you have had kidney stones, ask your doctor

ingredients.en: A few mint leaves, ½ apple, lemon
ingredients.hi: कुछ पुदीना पत्ते, आधा सेब, नींबू

en: Wash the spinach and mint well; chop the cucumber and apple.
Blend everything with water.
Strain if you like, add lemon and drink fresh.
hi: पालक और पुदीना अच्छी तरह धोएं; खीरा और सेब काट लें।
सब कुछ पानी के साथ पीस लें।
चाहें तो छान लें, नींबू डालें और ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Beetroot, Carrot & Amla
benefits: Three winter favourites in one glass: nitrates from beetroot, beta-carotene from carrot and lots of vitamin C from amla
Amla's vitamin C helps the body use the iron in beetroot and greens
Less sweet than fruit-based juices
caution: Beetroot can turn urine pink (harmless). If you have had kidney stones or take BP medicines, ask your doctor
Drink it within 15 minutes of making; vitamin C fades as juice stands.

ingredients.en: A small piece of ginger, ½ glass water
ingredients.hi: छोटा टुकड़ा अदरक, आधा गिलास पानी

en: Peel and chop the beetroot and carrots; deseed the amla.
Blend everything with ginger and water.
Strain and drink fresh.
hi: चुकंदर और गाजर छीलकर काटें; आंवले की गुठली निकालें।
अदरक और पानी के साथ सब पीस लें।
छानकर ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Orange, Carrot & Ginger
benefits: Vitamin C from orange and beta-carotene from carrot make a strong winter pair
Ginger adds warmth; it is also known to ease mild nausea
Kids usually like the sweet-tangy taste
caution: Acidic; skip it if you get reflux
Drink it within 15 minutes of making; vitamin C fades as juice stands.

en: Peel the oranges and remove seeds; peel and chop the carrots.
Blend the carrots and ginger with water, then add the orange and blend a few seconds more.
Strain and drink fresh.
hi: संतरे छीलकर बीज निकालें; गाजर छीलकर काटें।
गाजर और अदरक को पानी के साथ पीसें, फिर संतरा डालकर कुछ सेकंड और चलाएं।
छानकर ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Carrot, Apple & Ginger
benefits: Beta-carotene from carrots for eyes and skin
Apple makes it naturally sweet without sugar
Ginger gives a gentle warm kick in winter
caution: Juice has less fibre than the whole fruit and vegetables; one small glass is plenty
Drink it within 15 minutes of making; vitamin C fades as juice stands.

en: Wash, peel and chop the carrots and apple.
Blend with ginger and water.
Strain, add lemon and drink fresh.
hi: गाजर और सेब धोकर, छीलकर काटें।
अदरक और पानी के साथ पीसें।
छानकर नींबू डालें और ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Pineapple, Cucumber & Mint
benefits: Cucumber makes it light and hydrating; pineapple adds vitamin C
Fresh pineapple's bromelain and mint make it a nice drink after a meal
Less sugar than plain pineapple juice
caution: Pineapple can sting mouth ulcers
Drink it within 15 minutes of making; vitamin C fades as juice stands.

ingredients.en: Lemon, a pinch of black salt

en: Peel and chop the pineapple and cucumber.
Blend with mint and a little water.
Strain, add lemon and black salt, and serve cool.
hi: अनानास और खीरा छीलकर काटें।
पुदीना और थोड़े पानी के साथ पीसें।
छानकर नींबू और काला नमक डालें और ठंडा परोसें।

name: Papaya, Pineapple & Orange
benefits: A tropical mix full of vitamin C
Papaya adds beta-carotene, folate and fibre
Papaya and fresh pineapple both have natural enzymes (papain, bromelain)
caution: Use only ripe papaya, especially in pregnancy
Naturally sweet; keep to one small glass if you have diabetes

en: Cut the papaya and pineapple into pieces; peel and deseed the orange.
Blend everything with water till smooth.
Serve without straining, so you keep the fibre.
hi: पपीता और अनानास के टुकड़े करें; संतरा छीलकर बीज निकालें।
सब कुछ पानी के साथ चिकना पीसें।
बिना छाने परोसें ताकि रेशा बना रहे।

name: Tomato, Carrot & Beetroot (Veg Juice)
benefits: A vegetable juice with far less sugar than fruit juices
Lycopene from tomato, beta-carotene from carrot and nitrates from beetroot
A good choice for people watching their sugar
caution: Keep salt low
Same cautions as beetroot juice for kidney stones and BP medicines

ingredients.en: Lemon, black pepper, a few coriander leaves
ingredients.hi: नींबू, काली मिर्च, थोड़े धनिया पत्ते

en: Wash and chop the vegetables.
Blend with a little water and coriander.
Strain, add lemon and pepper, and drink fresh.
hi: सब्ज़ियां धोकर काटें।
थोड़े पानी और धनिये के साथ पीसें।
छान लें, नींबू और काली मिर्च डालें और ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Pomegranate & Beetroot
benefits: Pomegranate polyphenols plus beetroot nitrates: a heart-friendly pair
Pomegranate makes beetroot taste much better
Gives folate and potassium
caution: If you take blood pressure or blood-thinning medicines, ask your doctor before drinking it daily
Beetroot can turn urine pink (harmless)

en: Peel and chop the beetroot.
Blend with the pomegranate seeds and water for a few seconds.
Strain, add lemon and drink fresh.
hi: चुकंदर छीलकर काटें।
अनार के दानों और पानी के साथ कुछ सेकंड पीसें।
छान लें, नींबू डालें और ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Cucumber, Mint & Lemon
benefits: Almost no sugar and very few calories
Very hydrating on hot days
Lemon adds vitamin C
caution: Cut off and taste the ends of the cucumber; skip it if very bitter

ingredients.en: 1 lemon, a pinch of black salt

en: Peel and chop the cucumbers.
Blend with mint and a little cold water.
Strain, add lemon and black salt, and serve cold.
hi: खीरे छीलकर काटें।
पुदीना और थोड़े ठंडे पानी के साथ पीसें।
छान लें, नींबू और काला नमक डालें और ठंडा परोसें।

name: Mosambi & Pomegranate
benefits: Vitamin C from mosambi and polyphenols from pomegranate
Gentle on the stomach; a common choice when someone is recovering
Fresh, with no added sugar
caution: Whole fruit gives more fibre; keep juice to one small glass
Drink it within 15 minutes of making; vitamin C fades as juice stands.

en: Squeeze the mosambi.
Pulse the pomegranate seeds for a few seconds and strain.
Mix both juices and drink fresh.
hi: मौसमी का रस निकालें।
अनार के दाने कुछ सेकंड पीसकर छान लें।
दोनों रस मिलाकर ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Spinach, Amla & Apple
benefits: Spinach gives folate and vitamin K; amla adds plenty of vitamin C
Vitamin C helps the body take up the iron from spinach
Apple softens the green taste
caution: If you take blood thinners like warfarin, keep greens steady and ask your doctor
Spinach is high in oxalates; ask your doctor if you have had kidney stones

en: Wash the spinach well; deseed the amla and chop the apple.
Blend everything with water.
Strain if you like, add lemon and drink fresh.
hi: पालक अच्छी तरह धोएं; आंवले की गुठली निकालें और सेब काटें।
सब कुछ पानी के साथ पीसें।
चाहें तो छान लें, नींबू डालें और ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Kiwi & Green Apple
benefits: Kiwi is very rich in vitamin C and fibre
Blended with its pulp, it helps keep you regular
Green apple adds tang with less sugar than red
caution: Kiwi allergy can cause an itchy mouth; stop if this happens
Don't strain it; keep the pulp

en: Peel the kiwis; core and chop the apple.
Blend with water and mint for a few seconds.
Pour without straining and drink fresh.
hi: कीवी छीलें; सेब का बीच निकालकर काटें।
पानी और पुदीने के साथ कुछ सेकंड पीसें।
बिना छाने डालें और ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Strawberry & Orange
benefits: Strawberries and oranges are both rich in vitamin C
Strawberries add folate and plant pigments (anthocyanins)
A sweet seasonal treat in strawberry season (December to March)
caution: Wash strawberries well just before using
Some people are allergic to strawberries

en: Wash and hull the strawberries.
Blend with the orange segments and water.
Strain if you like and serve fresh.
hi: स्ट्रॉबेरी धोकर ऊपर का हरा हिस्सा हटाएं।
संतरे की फांकों और पानी के साथ पीसें।
चाहें तो छान लें और ताज़ा परोसें।

name: Amla, Ginger & Haldi Shot
benefits: A small, strong winter shot: vitamin C from amla, warmth from ginger
Turmeric with a pinch of black pepper (which helps the body absorb it)
Very low in sugar
caution: Strong and acidic; dilute it and don't take it on an empty stomach if you get acidity
Avoid large amounts if you take blood thinners or have gallstones; ask your doctor
Take a small shot, not a big glass

ingredients.en: ¼ tsp haldi and a pinch of black pepper
ingredients.hi: चौथाई छोटा चम्मच हल्दी और चुटकी भर काली मिर्च

ingredients.en: ½ cup water, a little honey (optional)
ingredients.hi: आधा कप पानी, थोड़ा शहद (चाहें तो)

en: Deseed the amla and chop with the ginger.
Blend with haldi, pepper and water; strain.
Drink a small shot (about 50 ml); keep the rest in the fridge for one day only.
hi: आंवले की गुठली निकालें और अदरक के साथ काटें।
हल्दी, काली मिर्च और पानी के साथ पीसकर छान लें।
एक छोटा शॉट (लगभग 50 मिली) पिएं; बाकी फ्रिज में बस एक दिन रखें।

name: Amla Juice
benefits: Amla is one of the richest sources of vitamin C, which the immune system needs
Vitamin C helps the body take up iron from dal, greens and roti
Very low in sugar when made without sweetener
caution: It is sour and acidic: always dilute it with water and avoid it on a very empty stomach if you get acidity
Amla may lower blood sugar a little; if you take diabetes medicines, check with your doctor before drinking it daily

ingredients.en: A pinch of black salt or a little honey
ingredients.hi: चुटकी भर काला नमक या थोड़ा शहद

en: Wash the amla, cut into pieces and remove the seeds.
Blend with a glass of water till smooth.
Strain if you like, add a pinch of black salt, and drink fresh.
hi: आंवले धोकर टुकड़े करें और गुठली निकाल दें।
एक गिलास पानी के साथ मिक्सी में चिकना पीस लें।
चाहें तो छान लें, चुटकी भर काला नमक डालें और ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Beetroot Juice
benefits: Rich in natural nitrates; in studies a daily glass lowered blood pressure a little (about 3–4 points)
The same nitrates may help stamina during exercise
Gives folate and some iron
caution: It can turn urine or stool pink or red; this is harmless
Beetroot is high in oxalates; if you have had kidney stones, ask your doctor
If you take blood pressure medicines, tell your doctor before drinking it daily

ingredients.en: ½ apple or a small piece of ginger
ingredients.hi: आधा सेब या छोटा टुकड़ा अदरक

ingredients.en: ½ glass water and a squeeze of lemon
ingredients.hi: आधा गिलास पानी और थोड़ा नींबू

en: Peel the beetroot and cut into small pieces.
Blend with the apple or ginger and water.
Strain, add lemon and drink fresh.
hi: चुकंदर छीलकर छोटे टुकड़े करें।
सेब या अदरक और पानी के साथ मिक्सी में पीस लें।
छान लें, नींबू डालें और ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Carrot Juice
benefits: Carrots are full of beta-carotene, which the body turns into vitamin A for healthy eyes and skin
Naturally sweet, so children usually like it
Best with a few drops of oil or with a meal, which helps the body absorb vitamin A
caution: Juice has less fibre than whole carrots; one small glass is plenty

ingredients.hi: 3 गाजर (सर्दी की लाल गाजर सबसे अच्छी)

en: Wash, peel and chop the carrots.
Blend with ginger and water till smooth.
Strain, add a squeeze of lemon and drink fresh.
hi: गाजर धोकर, छीलकर काट लें।
अदरक और पानी के साथ चिकना पीस लें।
छान लें, थोड़ा नींबू डालें और ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Lauki Juice
benefits: Mostly water, very low in calories and sugar
Light and cooling in hot weather
Gives some potassium and vitamin C
caution: IMPORTANT: taste a small piece of the raw lauki first. If it is bitter, throw it away. Bitter lauki juice can cause severe vomiting and has caused deaths in India
Never mix lauki juice with karela juice
Drink it fresh; don't keep it for later

ingredients.en: ½ glass water, lemon, black salt
ingredients.hi: आधा गिलास पानी, नींबू, काला नमक

en: Cut a small piece of the lauki and taste it. If it is bitter, do not use it.
Peel and chop the lauki, then blend with mint and water.
Strain, add lemon and black salt, and drink at once.
hi: लौकी का छोटा टुकड़ा काटकर चखें। कड़वी हो तो बिल्कुल इस्तेमाल न करें।
लौकी छीलकर काटें, पुदीना और पानी के साथ पीस लें।
छान लें, नींबू और काला नमक डालें और तुरंत पिएं।

name: Karela Juice
benefits: Traditionally taken to help manage blood sugar; some studies show a small effect
Very low in sugar and calories
Gives vitamin C
caution: If you take insulin or diabetes tablets, it can push sugar too low; ask your doctor and check your sugar
Avoid in pregnancy
Drink only a small cup; too much can upset the stomach
Never mix with lauki juice

ingredients.en: Lemon and a pinch of salt

en: Wash the karela, scrape lightly, remove seeds and chop.
Blend with water till smooth and strain.
Add lemon and salt; drink a small cup.
hi: करेला धोकर हल्का छील लें, बीज निकालकर काट लें।
पानी के साथ पीसकर छान लें।
नींबू और नमक डालें; छोटा कप ही पिएं।

name: Sugarcane Juice
benefits: Quick energy on a hot afternoon
Fresh juice with ginger and lemon is a classic Indian summer drink
Gives some potassium
caution: It is very high in sugar; people with diabetes should avoid it
Drink only from clean stalls that use fresh cane and clean ice, or skip the ice

ingredients.en: Fresh sugarcane juice from a clean stall
ingredients.hi: साफ़ ठेले से ताज़ा गन्ने का रस

ingredients.en: A little lemon (and ginger, if not Jain)
ingredients.hi: थोड़ा नींबू (जैन न हों तो अदरक भी)

en: Buy from a clean stall and ask for lemon (and ginger, if you like) to be pressed in.
Ask for no ice, or ice made from clean water.
Drink at once; it darkens quickly.
hi: साफ़ ठेले से लें और नींबू (चाहें तो अदरक भी) डलवाएं।
बर्फ़ न डलवाएं, या साफ़ पानी की बर्फ़ ही लें।
तुरंत पिएं; रस जल्दी काला पड़ जाता है।

name: Watermelon Juice
benefits: More than 90% water, so it is great for staying hydrated
Gives lycopene, the red plant pigment also found in tomatoes
Naturally sweet with no added sugar needed
caution: Whole watermelon pieces are even better: they keep you full longer

ingredients.en: A few mint leaves and lemon

en: Remove the seeds and blend the watermelon with mint.
Strain if you like and add a squeeze of lemon.
Serve straight away.
hi: बीज निकालकर तरबूज़ को पुदीने के साथ पीस लें।
चाहें तो छान लें और थोड़ा नींबू निचोड़ें।
तुरंत परोसें।

name: Pomegranate Juice
benefits: Rich in polyphenols (plant antioxidants) that are studied for heart health
Gives vitamin C and potassium
Fresh home-made juice has no added sugar
caution: Packed 'pomegranate drinks' are often mostly sugar; fresh is best
If you take blood thinners or many regular medicines, ask your doctor before drinking it daily

en: Take out the seeds (arils).
Pulse in a mixer for a few seconds only, so the white seeds don't crush.
Strain and drink fresh.
hi: अनार के दाने निकाल लें।
मिक्सी में बस कुछ सेकंड चलाएं ताकि बीज न पिसें।
छानकर ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Mosambi Juice
benefits: Sweet lime is a good source of vitamin C
Gentle on the stomach; often given when someone is unwell and not eating much
Hydrating
caution: Eating the whole fruit gives you the fibre too; keep juice to one small glass

en: Cut the mosambi in half.
Squeeze in a citrus press.
Add a pinch of black salt and drink at once.
hi: मौसमी को बीच से काटें।
जूसर या हाथ के प्रेस से रस निकालें।
चुटकी भर काला नमक डालें और तुरंत पिएं।

name: Orange Juice
benefits: A good source of vitamin C, which the immune system and skin need
Gives folate and potassium
Fresh juice has no added sugar, unlike packed 'orange drinks'
caution: It is acidic; skip it if it gives you acidity or reflux
Whole oranges keep the fibre; one small glass of juice a day is plenty
Drink it within 15 minutes of making; vitamin C fades as juice stands.

en: Peel the oranges and remove the seeds.
Squeeze in a citrus press, or blend the segments briefly and strain.
Add a pinch of black salt if you like and drink at once.
hi: संतरे छीलकर बीज निकाल दें।
हाथ के प्रेस से रस निकालें, या फांकें हल्का पीसकर छान लें।
चाहें तो चुटकी भर काला नमक डालें और तुरंत पिएं।

name: Pineapple Juice
benefits: Rich in vitamin C and manganese
Fresh pineapple has bromelain, an enzyme that breaks down protein; it is lost in tinned juice
Sweet and tangy, so it mixes well with vegetable juices
caution: It is acidic and can sting mouth ulcers
It is naturally sweet; people with diabetes should keep it small
Drink it within 15 minutes of making; vitamin C fades as juice stands.

en: Peel the pineapple, remove the hard core and cut into pieces.
Blend with mint and water.
Strain and serve fresh.
hi: अनानास छीलकर बीच का सख्त हिस्सा निकालें और टुकड़े करें।
पुदीना और पानी के साथ पीस लें।
छानकर ताज़ा परोसें।

name: Guava Juice
benefits: Guava is one of the richest fruits in vitamin C, about four times more than orange by weight
Blended (not strained too much) it keeps a lot of fibre
Lower in sugar than most fruit juices
caution: Strain out the hard seeds if they bother you
Drink it within 15 minutes of making; vitamin C fades as juice stands.

ingredients.en: Lemon, black salt and a pinch of chaat masala
ingredients.hi: नींबू, काला नमक और चुटकी भर चाट मसाला

en: Wash the guavas and cut into pieces.
Blend with water till smooth and pass through a strainer to remove the seeds.
Add lemon, black salt and chaat masala; drink fresh.
hi: अमरूद धोकर टुकड़े करें।
पानी के साथ चिकना पीसें और छलनी से बीज निकाल दें।
नींबू, काला नमक और चाट मसाला डालें; ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Papaya Juice
benefits: Ripe papaya gives vitamin C, beta-carotene (vitamin A) and folate
Blended with its pulp, it keeps the fibre that helps regular digestion
Naturally sweet; no sugar needed
caution: Use only fully ripe papaya. Unripe papaya is not safe in pregnancy
People with a latex allergy may react to papaya

en: Peel the papaya, remove the seeds and cut into pieces.
Blend with water (or milk for a smoothie) till smooth.
Add lemon and serve; no need to strain.
hi: पपीता छीलकर बीज निकालें और टुकड़े करें।
पानी (या स्मूदी के लिए दूध) के साथ चिकना पीसें।
नींबू डालकर परोसें; छानने की ज़रूरत नहीं।

name: Tomato Juice (Unsalted)
benefits: Rich in lycopene, the red plant pigment linked to heart health
In a year-long Japanese study, unsalted tomato juice was linked to slightly lower blood pressure in people with raised BP
Much lower in sugar than fruit juices
caution: Keep it unsalted or very lightly salted; packed tomato juice is often salty
Skip it if tomatoes give you acidity
High in potassium; people with kidney disease should ask their doctor

ingredients.en: A few drops of olive oil or a pinch of black pepper
ingredients.hi: कुछ बूंदें ऑलिव ऑयल या चुटकी भर काली मिर्च

en: Wash and chop the tomatoes; for a smoother taste blanch them in hot water for 2 minutes and peel.
Blend and strain.
Add lemon, pepper and a few drops of oil (it helps the body take up lycopene); drink fresh.
hi: टमाटर धोकर काटें; चिकने स्वाद के लिए 2 मिनट गरम पानी में डालकर छील लें।
पीसकर छान लें।
नींबू, काली मिर्च और कुछ बूंदें तेल डालें (इससे लाइकोपीन अच्छे से मिलता है); ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Kiwi Juice
benefits: Green kiwi is very rich in vitamin C
In trials, two green kiwis a day eased constipation; blend with the pulp to keep the fibre
Gives vitamin K and vitamin E
caution: Some people are allergic to kiwi (itchy mouth); stop if this happens
Don't strain it; the pulp is the useful part

ingredients.en: A few mint leaves, a little honey or jaggery (optional)
ingredients.hi: कुछ पुदीना पत्ते, थोड़ा शहद या गुड़ (चाहें तो)

en: Peel the kiwis and cut into pieces.
Blend with water and mint for a few seconds only, so the black seeds don't turn bitter.
Pour without straining and drink fresh.
hi: कीवी छीलकर टुकड़े करें।
पानी और पुदीने के साथ बस कुछ सेकंड पीसें ताकि काले बीज कड़वे न हों।
बिना छाने डालें और ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Black Grape Juice
benefits: Dark grape skins are rich in polyphenols (such as resveratrol) studied for heart health
Gives potassium and quick energy
Fresh home-made juice keeps more of the skin's goodness than packed juice
caution: It is high in natural sugar; people with diabetes should avoid it or take just a few sips
Wash grapes very well; soak in water with a little salt for 10 minutes

ingredients.en: Lemon and a pinch of black salt
ingredients.hi: नींबू और चुटकी भर काला नमक

en: Soak the grapes in salted water for 10 minutes and rinse well.
Blend with water and strain.
Add lemon and black salt; drink fresh.
hi: अंगूर 10 मिनट नमक वाले पानी में भिगोकर अच्छी तरह धो लें।
पानी के साथ पीसकर छान लें।
नींबू और काला नमक डालें; ताज़ा पिएं।

name: Jamun Juice
benefits: Jamun is rich in anthocyanins, the deep purple plant pigments
Traditionally used for blood sugar; human studies are few, so treat it as a healthy seasonal fruit, not a medicine
Low in sugar for a fruit drink
caution: If you take diabetes medicines, ask your doctor before drinking it daily
It stains clothes and teeth; rinse your mouth after

ingredients.en: Black salt, roasted cumin and lemon
ingredients.hi: काला नमक, भुना जीरा और नींबू

en: Wash the jamun and remove the seeds by pressing each one.
Blend the pulp with water and strain.
Add black salt, roasted cumin and lemon; serve cool.
hi: जामुन धोकर हर एक को दबाकर गुठली निकाल दें।
गूदे को पानी के साथ पीसकर छान लें।
काला नमक, भुना जीरा और नींबू डालकर ठंडा परोसें।

name: Ash Gourd Juice (Petha)
benefits: Mostly water and very low in calories and sugar
A popular light, cooling morning drink
Gives some vitamin C and potassium
caution: Like lauki, taste a small raw piece first; if it is bitter, throw it away
Most health claims about it are traditional; enjoy it as a light drink
Drink it fresh

ingredients.en: 1 cup ash gourd (white petha) pieces, taste-tested
ingredients.hi: 1 कप पेठे के टुकड़े (पहले चखकर देखें)

ingredients.en: Lemon and a pinch of black salt
ingredients.hi: नींबू और चुटकी भर काला नमक

en: Taste a small raw piece; if it is bitter, do not use it.
Peel, remove the seeds and blend with water.
Strain, add lemon and black salt, and drink at once.
hi: एक छोटा कच्चा टुकड़ा चखें; कड़वा हो तो इस्तेमाल न करें।
छीलकर बीज निकालें और पानी के साथ पीसें।
छान लें, नींबू और काला नमक डालें और तुरंत पिएं।

name: Muskmelon Juice
benefits: Mostly water, so it keeps you hydrated in summer
Orange flesh gives beta-carotene (vitamin A) and vitamin C
Naturally sweet; no sugar needed
caution: Wash the outside well before cutting; germs on the rind can get into the fruit
Cut melon spoils fast; make and drink it fresh

ingredients.en: ¼ glass cold water or milk
ingredients.hi: चौथाई गिलास ठंडा पानी या दूध

en: Scrub the melon under running water, then cut it and remove the seeds.
Blend with mint and a little water (or milk for a shake).
Serve cold straight away.
hi: खरबूजे को बहते पानी में रगड़कर धोएं, फिर काटकर बीज निकालें।
पुदीना और थोड़े पानी (या शेक के लिए दूध) के साथ पीसें।
तुरंत ठंडा परोसें।

name: Nimbu Pani (Shikanji)
benefits: Replaces water and salt lost in sweat on hot days
Lemon adds vitamin C
Cheap, quick and easy on the stomach
caution: Add little or no sugar; the drink is good without it.
Lemon is acidic and can wear tooth enamel; rinse your mouth with plain water after

ingredients.en: A pinch of salt and roasted cumin powder
ingredients.hi: चुटकी भर नमक और भुना जीरा पाउडर
1 छोटा चम्मच चीनी या गुड़ (चाहें तो)

en: Squeeze the lemon into the water.
Add salt, roasted cumin and a little sugar if you like.
Stir well and serve cool. On vrat days use sendha namak.
hi: नमक, भुना जीरा और चाहें तो थोड़ी चीनी डालें।
अच्छी तरह मिलाकर ठंडा परोसें। व्रत के दिन सेंधा नमक डालें।

name: Coconut Water
benefits: Natural electrolytes, mostly potassium, help after sweating, a long day out or loose motions
Light, low in calories and naturally a little sweet
Ready to drink, nothing to cook
caution: It is high in potassium (about 600 mg in a big glass). People with kidney disease or on potassium-saving medicines should ask their doctor first
Packed coconut water may have added sugar; read the label

en: Ask the seller to open a fresh tender coconut.
Pour the water into a clean glass.
Drink within an hour; scoop out the soft malai too.
hi: ताज़ा हरा नारियल खुलवाएं।
पानी साफ़ गिलास में डालें।
एक घंटे के अंदर पी लें; नरम मलाई भी खा लें।

name: Masala Chaas
benefits: Home-made curd has live cultures that are good for the gut
Cooling and light after a heavy lunch
Gives some calcium and protein with very few calories
caution: Use salt lightly if you have high blood pressure

ingredients.en: Roasted cumin, black salt, a few mint or coriander leaves
ingredients.hi: भुना जीरा, काला नमक, थोड़े पुदीना या धनिया पत्ते

en: Whisk the curd with cold water till smooth.
Add roasted cumin, black salt and chopped mint or coriander.
Stir and serve cool after a meal. On vrat days use sendha namak.
hi: दही में ठंडा पानी डालकर अच्छी तरह फेंट लें।
भुना जीरा, काला नमक और कटा पुदीना या धनिया डालें।
मिलाकर खाने के बाद ठंडी परोसें। व्रत में सेंधा नमक डालें।

name: Sattu Sharbat
benefits: Roasted chana flour gives plant protein and fibre that keep you full
A traditional summer drink in Bihar and UP for long, hot days
Slow energy, without much sugar
caution: Drink it fresh; sattu thickens if kept

ingredients.en: Lemon, black salt and roasted cumin
ingredients.hi: नींबू, काला नमक और भुना जीरा

en: Mix the sattu in a little water to make a smooth paste.
Add the rest of the water, lemon juice, black salt and cumin.
Stir well and drink straight away.
hi: सत्तू को थोड़े पानी में घोलकर चिकना पेस्ट बनाएं।
बाकी पानी, नींबू का रस, काला नमक और जीरा डालें।
अच्छी तरह मिलाकर तुरंत पिएं।

name: Haldi Doodh (Turmeric Milk)
benefits: Milk gives calcium and protein
Turmeric's curcumin is studied for calming inflammation; a pinch of black pepper helps the body absorb it
A warm, soothing drink at bedtime in winter
caution: Add little or no sugar; the drink is good without it.
Turmeric in food amounts is safe; large supplement doses are different, so ask your doctor if you take blood thinners

en: Heat the milk with turmeric and black pepper.
Let it simmer for 3–4 minutes, stirring.
Add a little jaggery off the heat and drink warm.
hi: दूध में हल्दी और काली मिर्च डालकर गरम करें।
3–4 मिनट हिलाते हुए धीमी आंच पर पकाएं।
आंच से उतारकर थोड़ा गुड़ डालें और गुनगुना पिएं।

name: Jeera Water
benefits: Traditionally taken for digestion and bloating
A tasty way to drink more water with no sugar
Almost no calories
caution: Benefits are mostly traditional; it is not a weight-loss cure

en: Soak the jeera in water overnight, or boil it for 5 minutes.
Strain.
Drink warm or at room temperature.
hi: जीरा रात भर पानी में भिगो दें, या 5 मिनट उबाल लें।
छान लें।
गुनगुना या सामान्य तापमान पर पिएं।

name: Ajwain Water
benefits: A traditional home remedy for gas and indigestion after a heavy meal
Warm and comforting in winter
No sugar, almost no calories
caution: Benefits are mostly traditional
Avoid large amounts in pregnancy; ask your doctor

en: Boil the ajwain in water for 5 minutes.
Strain and let it cool a little.
Sip warm after a meal.
hi: अजवाइन को पानी में 5 मिनट उबालें।
छानकर थोड़ा ठंडा होने दें।
खाने के बाद गुनगुना घूंट-घूंट पिएं।

name: Methi Water
benefits: Methi seeds are rich in soluble fibre, which slows how fast sugar enters the blood
Traditionally taken in the morning for digestion
No added sugar
caution: If you take diabetes medicines, ask your doctor; it can add to their effect
Avoid in pregnancy unless your doctor agrees

en: Soak the methi seeds in water overnight.
In the morning, strain the water.
Drink it; the soaked seeds can be chewed or added to dal.
hi: मेथी दाना रात भर पानी में भिगो दें।
सुबह पानी छान लें।
पानी पी लें; भीगे दाने चबा सकते हैं या दाल में डाल सकते हैं।

name: Aam Panna
benefits: The classic drink to beat summer heat, made from raw mango
Raw mango gives vitamin C
With salt and cumin it helps replace what you lose in sweat
caution: Traditional recipes use a lot of sugar or jaggery; use half

ingredients.en: Roasted cumin, black salt, a few mint leaves
ingredients.hi: भुना जीरा, काला नमक, कुछ पुदीना पत्ते

en: Boil or roast the raw mangoes till soft, cool and squeeze out the pulp.
Blend the pulp with jaggery, roasted cumin, black salt and mint.
Mix 3–4 spoons of this with a glass of cold water and serve.
hi: कच्चे आम उबालकर या भूनकर नरम करें, ठंडा करके गूदा निकालें।
गूदे को गुड़, भुना जीरा, काला नमक और पुदीने के साथ पीस लें।
एक गिलास ठंडे पानी में 3–4 चम्मच मिलाकर परोसें।

name: Kokum Sharbat
benefits: A Konkan favourite that cools the body on hot days
Traditionally taken for acidity and digestion
Kokum has plant compounds (garcinol, anthocyanins) being studied for their effects
caution: Ready-made kokum syrup is very sugary; dilute well or make it at home

en: Soak the kokum in a cup of warm water for 1 hour, then squeeze and strain.
Add jaggery, roasted cumin and black salt.
Mix with cold water and serve.
hi: कोकम को एक कप गुनगुने पानी में 1 घंटा भिगोएं, फिर मसलकर छान लें।
गुड़, भुना जीरा और काला नमक डालें।
ठंडे पानी में मिलाकर परोसें।

name: Bel Sharbat
benefits: Bel (wood apple) pulp is rich in fibre and is a traditional summer drink for the stomach
Cooling in the hottest months
Gives vitamin C and some minerals
caution: Add little or no sugar; the drink is good without it.

en: Break the bel and scoop out the pulp.
Soak it in a glass of water for 20 minutes, mash and strain out the seeds and fibres.
Add jaggery and the rest of the water; serve cool.
hi: बेल तोड़कर गूदा निकालें।
एक गिलास पानी में 20 मिनट भिगोएं, मसलकर बीज और रेशे छान लें।
गुड़ और बाकी पानी डालकर ठंडा परोसें।

name: Jaljeera
benefits: Cumin, mint and amchur make a tangy drink that is traditionally taken to whet the appetite
Helps you drink more water on hot days
Little or no sugar
caution: Ready-made jaljeera powder is salty; go easy if you have high blood pressure

ingredients.en: ½ tsp amchur, black salt, lemon
ingredients.hi: आधा छोटा चम्मच अमचूर, काला नमक, नींबू

en: Grind the mint with a little water to a paste.
Mix in cumin, amchur, black salt and lemon.
Add cold water, stir and serve with a few boondi if you like.
hi: पुदीना थोड़े पानी के साथ पीसकर पेस्ट बनाएं।
जीरा, अमचूर, काला नमक और नींबू मिलाएं।
ठंडा पानी डालकर मिलाएं, चाहें तो थोड़ी बूंदी डालकर परोसें।

name: Tulsi Adrak Kadha
benefits: A warm traditional drink many families take in cold weather
Ginger and the steam soothe a scratchy throat
Made with spices you already have
nutrients: Plant compounds from ginger, tulsi and spices
caution: It soothes; it doesn't cure a cold or fever. See a doctor for high fever, trouble breathing or a cough that lasts
Strong kadha every day can cause acidity; keep it mild

ingredients.en: 2 black peppercorns, 1 clove, a small piece of cinnamon
ingredients.hi: 2 काली मिर्च, 1 लौंग, छोटा टुकड़ा दालचीनी
2 कप पानी, स्वाद के लिए गुड़

en: Boil the water with tulsi, ginger and the spices.
Simmer for 8–10 minutes till it reduces to about one cup.
Strain, add a little jaggery and sip warm.
hi: पानी में तुलसी, अदरक और मसाले डालकर उबालें।
8–10 मिनट धीमी आंच पर पकाएं जब तक एक कप रह जाए।
छान लें, थोड़ा गुड़ डालें और गुनगुना पिएं।

name: Badam Milk
benefits: Milk and almonds give protein, calcium and vitamin E
Filling and comforting; good for growing children
A healthier choice than packed flavoured milk
caution: Add little or no sugar; the drink is good without it.
Not for anyone with a nut allergy

ingredients.hi: 8–10 बादाम, रात भर भीगे और छिले

ingredients.en: A pinch of cardamom and saffron

ingredients.hi: 1 छोटा चम्मच चीनी या गुड़ (चाहें तो)

en: Grind the soaked almonds with a little milk to a smooth paste.
Boil the rest of the milk, add the paste, cardamom and saffron, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Sweeten lightly and serve warm or chilled.
hi: भीगे बादाम थोड़े दूध के साथ चिकना पीस लें।
बाकी दूध उबालें, पेस्ट, इलायची और केसर डालकर 5 मिनट पकाएं।
हल्का मीठा करें और गरम या ठंडा परोसें।

name: Ragi Malt (Ragi Java)
benefits: Ragi (finger millet) is one of the best plant sources of calcium
Fibre and slow energy for the morning
A South Indian favourite for children and elders
caution: Cook it well so it isn't raw-tasting; stir to avoid lumps

ingredients.en: Jaggery, or salt and buttermilk for the savoury version
ingredients.hi: गुड़, या नमकीन के लिए नमक और छाछ

en: Mix the ragi flour in a little cold water so there are no lumps.
Pour into boiling water or milk and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes till it thickens.
Add jaggery (sweet) or let it cool and add buttermilk and salt (savoury).
hi: रागी आटा थोड़े ठंडे पानी में घोलें ताकि गांठें न रहें।
उबलते पानी या दूध में डालकर 5 मिनट हिलाते हुए गाढ़ा होने तक पकाएं।
मीठे के लिए गुड़ डालें, या ठंडा करके छाछ और नमक डालें (नमकीन)।

name: Thandai
benefits: Almonds, melon seeds and fennel in milk make a rich, cooling festive drink (Holi, Maha Shivratri)
Gives protein, calcium and healthy fats
Fennel and cardamom are traditionally taken for digestion
caution: It is rich and usually sweet; one small glass is enough
Not for anyone with a nut allergy

ingredients.en: 10 almonds, 1 tbsp melon seeds, 1 tsp fennel (saunf), 1 tsp poppy seeds
ingredients.hi: 10 बादाम, 1 बड़ा चम्मच मगज़, 1 छोटा चम्मच सौंफ, 1 छोटा चम्मच खसखस

ingredients.en: 4 black peppercorns, 3 cardamoms, a few rose petals
ingredients.hi: 4 काली मिर्च, 3 इलायची, कुछ गुलाब की पंखुड़ियां

en: Soak the nuts, seeds and spices in water for 2 hours.
Grind to a fine paste with a little milk.
Mix into chilled milk with sugar, strain and serve cold.
hi: मेवे, बीज और मसाले 2 घंटे पानी में भिगोएं।
थोड़े दूध के साथ बारीक पीस लें।
ठंडे दूध में चीनी के साथ मिलाएं, छानकर ठंडा परोसें।

name: Kanji (Black Carrot)
benefits: A tangy fermented winter drink from North India
Fermentation makes it a natural source of good bacteria for the gut
Black carrots are rich in anthocyanins, the same purple pigments as in jamun
caution: It is salty; go easy if you have high blood pressure
Use a clean glass jar and throw it away if it smells bad or grows mould

ingredients.en: 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp red chilli
ingredients.hi: 1 छोटा चम्मच नमक, आधा छोटा चम्मच लाल मिर्च

en: Cut the carrots (and beetroot) into sticks and put them in a clean glass jar.
Add the mustard, salt, chilli and water; cover with a cloth.
Keep in the sun for 3–4 days, stirring daily, till tangy. Strain and serve.
hi: गाजर (और चुकंदर) को लंबे टुकड़ों में काटकर साफ़ कांच के जार में डालें।
राई, नमक, मिर्च और पानी डालें; ऊपर कपड़ा बांधें।
3–4 दिन धूप में रखें, रोज़ हिलाएं, जब तक खट्टी न हो जाए। छानकर परोसें।

name: Sol Kadhi
benefits: A Konkan drink of kokum and coconut milk, taken after spicy meals
Traditionally used to settle acidity and help digestion
Cooling on hot days
caution: Coconut milk is rich; one small glass is enough

ingredients.hi: 1 छोटी लहसुन की कली, 1 हरी मिर्च

en: Squeeze the soaked kokum and strain the pink water.
Crush the garlic and green chilli and add with salt to the coconut milk.
Mix in the kokum water, add coriander and serve cool.
hi: भीगे कोकम मसलकर गुलाबी पानी छान लें।
लहसुन और हरी मिर्च कूटकर नमक के साथ नारियल के दूध में डालें।
कोकम का पानी मिलाएं, धनिया डालकर ठंडा परोसें।

name: Lassi
benefits: Curd gives protein and calcium
Home-made curd brings live cultures that are good for the gut
Filling and cooling in summer
caution: Shop lassi is often very sweet; make it at home with little sugar

ingredients.en: ½ cup cold water or milk
ingredients.hi: आधा कप ठंडा पानी या दूध

ingredients.en: 1–2 tsp sugar, a pinch of cardamom
ingredients.hi: 1–2 छोटे चम्मच चीनी, चुटकी भर इलायची

en: Whisk the curd till smooth.
Add water or milk, sugar and cardamom and whisk till frothy.
Serve cold.
hi: दही को चिकना होने तक फेंटें।
पानी या दूध, चीनी और इलायची डालकर झागदार होने तक फेंटें।
ठंडी परोसें।

name: Classic Virgin Mojito
highlights: Fresh lime, crushed mint and fizzy soda: the classic party cooler
Ready in five minutes with things you already have
Everyone can have it; there is no alcohol
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.

ingredients.en: 1 cup chilled soda or lemon-lime soda
ingredients.hi: 1 कप ठंडा सोडा या लेमन सोडा

en: Put the lime wedges, mint leaves and sugar in a glass and press them with a muddler or the back of a spoon to release the juice and mint oils.
Fill the glass with crushed ice.
Top up with chilled soda, stir gently and garnish with a mint sprig and a lime wheel.
hi: गिलास में नींबू के टुकड़े, पुदीना पत्ते और चीनी डालें और मडलर या चम्मच के पिछले हिस्से से दबाएं ताकि रस और पुदीने की खुशबू निकले।
गिलास में कुटी बर्फ़ भर दें।
ऊपर से ठंडा सोडा डालें, हल्का मिलाएं और पुदीने की टहनी व नींबू के गोल टुकड़े से सजाएं।

name: Watermelon Mojito
highlights: Sweet watermelon with lime and mint, pink and pretty
Very refreshing on a hot summer evening
Watermelon makes it naturally sweet, so it needs less sugar
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.
Use fresh watermelon the same day you cut it

ingredients.hi: 1 कप तरबूज़ के टुकड़े, बीज निकाले

ingredients.en: Ice and ½ cup chilled soda
ingredients.hi: बर्फ़ और आधा कप ठंडा सोडा

en: Muddle the watermelon, lime, mint and sugar in a glass till juicy.
Add ice.
Top up with soda, stir and garnish with a small watermelon wedge.
hi: गिलास में तरबूज़, नींबू, पुदीना और चीनी को दबाकर रसदार बनाएं।
बर्फ़ डालें।
ऊपर से सोडा डालें, मिलाएं और तरबूज़ के छोटे टुकड़े से सजाएं।

name: Strawberry Mojito
highlights: Juicy strawberries crushed with lime and mint
Bright red and great for parties in strawberry season
Kids love it
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.
Wash strawberries well just before using

en: Hull and halve the strawberries.
Muddle them with lime, mint and sugar in a glass.
Add ice, top up with soda, stir and garnish with a strawberry.
hi: स्ट्रॉबेरी का हरा हिस्सा हटाकर आधा काटें।
गिलास में नींबू, पुदीना और चीनी के साथ दबाएं।
बर्फ़ डालें, ऊपर से सोडा डालें, मिलाएं और स्ट्रॉबेरी से सजाएं।

name: Kala Khatta Mojito
highlights: The tangy, purple taste of the street-side gola, as a fizzy mojito
A sprinkle of black salt and chaat masala gives it a desi kick
A guaranteed hit at kids' parties
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.
Kala khatta syrup is very sweet and coloured; use just a little

ingredients.en: A pinch of black salt and chaat masala
ingredients.hi: चुटकी भर काला नमक और चाट मसाला

ingredients.en: Crushed ice and 1 cup chilled soda
ingredients.hi: कुटी बर्फ़ और 1 कप ठंडा सोडा

en: Muddle the lime and mint in a glass.
Add the kala khatta syrup, black salt, chaat masala and crushed ice.
Top up with soda, stir and serve at once.
hi: गिलास में नींबू और पुदीना दबाएं।
काला खट्टा सिरप, काला नमक, चाट मसाला और कुटी बर्फ़ डालें।
ऊपर से सोडा डालें, मिलाएं और तुरंत परोसें।

name: Kiwi Mojito
highlights: Tangy green kiwi with lime and mint
Looks beautiful with the black kiwi seeds in the glass
Fresh and not too sweet
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.

en: Muddle the kiwi, lime, mint and sugar in a glass.
Add ice.
Top up with soda, stir and garnish with a kiwi slice.
hi: गिलास में कीवी, नींबू, पुदीना और चीनी दबाएं।
बर्फ़ डालें।
ऊपर से सोडा डालें, मिलाएं और कीवी के टुकड़े से सजाएं।

name: Green Apple Mojito
highlights: Crisp, sour green apple with mint and lime
A café favourite you can make at home
Light green and very refreshing
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.
Green apple syrup is sugary; grated fresh green apple is a lighter choice

ingredients.en: ½ green apple, finely chopped (or 1 tbsp green apple syrup)
ingredients.hi: आधा हरा सेब, बारीक कटा (या 1 बड़ा चम्मच ग्रीन एप्पल सिरप)

en: Muddle the apple, lime, mint and sugar in a glass.
Add ice.
Top up with soda, stir and garnish with thin apple slices.
hi: गिलास में सेब, नींबू, पुदीना और चीनी दबाएं।
बर्फ़ डालें।
ऊपर से सोडा डालें, मिलाएं और सेब की पतली फांकों से सजाएं।

name: Mango Mojito
highlights: Ripe mango pulp with lime and mint: summer in a glass
Thick, sweet and tangy at the same time
Use Alphonso or any sweet mango
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.
Ripe mango is already sweet; you may not need sugar

ingredients.hi: आधा कप पके आम का गूदा

ingredients.en: Ice and ¾ cup chilled soda
ingredients.hi: बर्फ़ और पौना कप ठंडा सोडा

en: Muddle the lime, mint and sugar in a glass.
Add the mango pulp and ice.
Top up slowly with soda, stir and garnish with a mango slice.
hi: गिलास में नींबू, पुदीना और चीनी दबाएं।
आम का गूदा और बर्फ़ डालें।
धीरे-धीरे सोडा डालें, मिलाएं और आम के टुकड़े से सजाएं।

name: Pomegranate (Anar) Mojito
highlights: Ruby-red pomegranate with lime and mint
The seeds sparkle in the glass, perfect for festive evenings
Tart and lightly sweet
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.

en: Muddle most of the pomegranate seeds with lime, mint and sugar in a glass.
Add ice and the rest of the seeds.
Top up with soda and stir gently.
hi: गिलास में ज़्यादातर अनार के दाने नींबू, पुदीना और चीनी के साथ दबाएं।
बर्फ़ और बचे हुए दाने डालें।
ऊपर से सोडा डालें और हल्का मिलाएं।

name: Virgin Piña Colada
highlights: Pineapple and creamy coconut milk blended with ice
Tastes like a beach holiday
Thick, smooth and filling
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.
Coconut milk is rich; one glass is plenty

en: Put pineapple, coconut milk, sugar and ice in a blender.
Blend till smooth and frothy.
Pour into a glass and garnish with a pineapple wedge.
hi: अनानास, नारियल का दूध, चीनी और बर्फ़ मिक्सी में डालें।
चिकना और झागदार होने तक चलाएं।
गिलास में डालें और अनानास के टुकड़े से सजाएं।

name: Blue Lagoon
highlights: Bright blue and fizzy: it always gets a 'wow' at parties
Lemony and sweet
Takes two minutes
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.
Blue curaçao syrup (non-alcoholic) is mostly sugar and colour; keep it for parties

ingredients.hi: 2 बड़े चम्मच ब्लू कुराकाओ सिरप (बिना अल्कोहल)

en: Fill a glass with ice.
Add the blue syrup and lemon juice.
Pour the soda slowly, stir once and garnish with a lemon slice.
hi: गिलास में बर्फ़ भरें।
ब्लू सिरप और नींबू का रस डालें।
धीरे-धीरे सोडा डालें, एक बार मिलाएं और नींबू के टुकड़े से सजाएं।

name: Shirley Temple
highlights: A classic pink mocktail with grenadine and fizzy ginger ale
Topped with a cherry, children love it
Sweet and sparkly
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.

ingredients.en: 1 cup chilled ginger ale or lemon-lime soda
ingredients.hi: 1 कप ठंडा जिंजर एल या लेमन सोडा

ingredients.en: Ice, a lime wedge, a cherry

en: Fill a glass with ice and pour in the soda.
Slowly add the grenadine; it sinks and makes a pink sunset.
Squeeze in a little lime and top with a cherry.
hi: गिलास में बर्फ़ भरें और सोडा डालें।
धीरे से ग्रेनाडीन डालें; वह नीचे बैठकर गुलाबी रंग बनाएगा।
थोड़ा नींबू निचोड़ें और ऊपर चेरी लगाएं।

name: Fruit Punch
highlights: Orange, pineapple and pomegranate juices with fizz and chopped fruit
Made in a big jug for a crowd
Colourful and fruity
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.
Make it with fresh juices instead of packed ones to cut the sugar

en: Mix the juices in a large jug.
Add the chopped fruit, mint and ice.
Just before serving, add soda and stir.
hi: एक बड़े जग में सारे रस मिलाएं।
कटे फल, पुदीना और बर्फ़ डालें।
परोसने से ठीक पहले सोडा डालकर मिलाएं।

name: Masala Soda (Banta Style)
highlights: The fizzy, salty-tangy street soda of Mumbai and Delhi
Lemon, black salt and jeera with soda; very little sugar
Great after a heavy meal
caution: It is salty; go easy if you have high blood pressure

ingredients.hi: आधा छोटा चम्मच भुना जीरा पाउडर

ingredients.en: ½ tsp black salt, a pinch of chaat masala
ingredients.hi: आधा छोटा चम्मच काला नमक, चुटकी भर चाट मसाला

en: Squeeze the lemon into a glass and add the masalas and sugar.
Add ice.
Pour in the soda (it will fizz up), stir and drink at once.
hi: गिलास में नींबू निचोड़ें और मसाले व चीनी डालें।
बर्फ़ डालें।
सोडा डालें (झाग उठेगा), मिलाएं और तुरंत पिएं।

name: Spicy Guava Mary
highlights: Pink guava juice with a red-chilli and salt rim, an Indian party favourite
Sweet, tangy and spicy in one sip
Uses fresh guava when it's in season
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or fresh guava instead of packed juice.
The chilli rim is hot; skip it for children

ingredients.en: A pinch of black salt and black pepper
ingredients.hi: चुटकी भर काला नमक और काली मिर्च

ingredients.en: Red chilli powder and salt for the rim
ingredients.hi: किनारे के लिए लाल मिर्च पाउडर और नमक

en: Rub lemon on the rim of a glass and dip it in chilli powder mixed with salt.
Fill with ice.
Mix guava juice, lemon, black salt and pepper, pour in and serve.
hi: गिलास के किनारे पर नींबू लगाकर नमक मिली लाल मिर्च में डुबोएं।
बर्फ़ भरें।
अमरूद का रस, नींबू, काला नमक और काली मिर्च मिलाकर डालें और परोसें।

name: Mango Tango
highlights: Mango and orange juice with a splash of soda
Golden, sunny and very fruity
A summer party crowd-pleaser
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.

ingredients.en: Ice and ½ cup chilled soda
ingredients.hi: बर्फ़ और आधा कप ठंडा सोडा

en: Whisk the mango pulp, orange juice and lemon juice together.
Pour over ice in a tall glass.
Top with soda and garnish with an orange slice.
hi: आम का गूदा, संतरे का रस और नींबू का रस फेंटकर मिलाएं।
लंबे गिलास में बर्फ़ पर डालें।
ऊपर से सोडा डालें और संतरे के टुकड़े से सजाएं।

name: Kokum Fizz
highlights: Konkan kokum syrup made sparkly with soda and mint
Deep pink, tangy and cooling
A desi alternative to cola
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less syrup, or plain soda instead of sweet soda.

ingredients.en: A pinch of roasted cumin and black salt
ingredients.hi: चुटकी भर भुना जीरा और काला नमक

en: Lightly crush the mint in a glass.
Add kokum syrup, cumin, black salt and ice.
Top with soda and stir.
hi: गिलास में पुदीना हल्का दबाएं।
कोकम शरबत, जीरा, काला नमक और बर्फ़ डालें।
ऊपर से सोडा डालें और मिलाएं।

name: Paan Cooler
highlights: All the flavour of a meetha paan, blended into a chilled drink
Betel leaf, gulkand and fennel: a perfect after-dinner treat
Unusual and memorable at parties
caution: A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less gulkand.
Use only fresh betel leaves; no tobacco, supari or lime (chuna)

ingredients.en: 1 scoop vanilla ice cream or ½ cup cold milk
ingredients.hi: 1 स्कूप वनीला आइसक्रीम या आधा कप ठंडा दूध

en: Tear the paan leaves and put them in a blender with gulkand, fennel and ice.
Add the ice cream or cold milk and blend till smooth.
Pour into a glass and garnish with tutti-frutti or rose petals.
hi: पान के पत्ते तोड़कर गुलकंद, सौंफ और बर्फ़ के साथ मिक्सी में डालें।
आइसक्रीम या ठंडा दूध डालकर चिकना पीस लें।
गिलास में डालें और टूटी-फ्रूटी या गुलाब की पंखुड़ियों से सजाएं।

name: South Indian Filter Coffee
highlights: Strong, frothy coffee served the Madras way in a steel tumbler and dabara
Coffee with a little chicory gives it the classic thick, bold taste
Pouring it between tumbler and dabara makes a light froth on top
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.

ingredients.en: 3 tbsp filter coffee powder (coffee with chicory)
ingredients.hi: 3 बड़े चम्मच फ़िल्टर कॉफ़ी पाउडर (चिकोरी वाला)

en: Put the coffee powder in the top part of the coffee filter and press it lightly with the plunger.
Pour the boiling water over it, cover, and let the decoction drip for 15–20 minutes.
Boil the milk.
In a steel tumbler, add sugar, ¼ cup decoction and the hot milk.
Pour between the tumbler and dabara 3–4 times to make it frothy. Serve hot.
hi: कॉफ़ी फ़िल्टर के ऊपर वाले हिस्से में कॉफ़ी पाउडर डालें और ढक्कन वाली प्लेट से हल्का दबाएं।
ऊपर से उबलता पानी डालें, ढक दें और 15–20 मिनट तक डिकॉक्शन टपकने दें।
दूध उबाल लें।
स्टील के गिलास में चीनी, ¼ कप डिकॉक्शन और गरम दूध डालें।
गिलास और कटोरी (डबरा) के बीच 3–4 बार उलट-पलट करें ताकि झाग बने। गरम परोसें।

name: Beaten Coffee (Indian Cappuccino)
highlights: Instant coffee and sugar beaten till pale and creamy, then topped with hot milk
Café-style foam at home with just a spoon and a cup
The classic Indian home coffee for guests
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.

en: Put coffee, sugar and the water in a cup.
Beat hard with a spoon for 3–4 minutes till light brown and creamy.
Pour the hot milk from a height so it foams.
Dust with cocoa powder and serve.
hi: कप में कॉफ़ी, चीनी और पानी डालें।
चम्मच से 3–4 मिनट ज़ोर से फेंटें, जब तक हल्का भूरा और क्रीमी न हो जाए।
गरम दूध ऊंचाई से डालें ताकि झाग बने।
ऊपर कोको पाउडर छिड़ककर परोसें।

name: Café Latte
highlights: Mild and milky: a little strong coffee with lots of hot, frothy milk
Smooth and not bitter, a good first coffee for tea drinkers
Froth the milk in a jar or with a hand frother
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.

ingredients.en: 1 tsp instant coffee or ¼ cup strong brewed coffee
ingredients.hi: 1 छोटा चम्मच इंस्टेंट कॉफ़ी या ¼ कप तेज़ बनी कॉफ़ी
2 बड़े चम्मच गरम पानी (इंस्टेंट कॉफ़ी के लिए)

en: Mix the coffee in the hot water (or use the brewed coffee) in a big cup.
Heat the milk till hot but not boiling.
Froth it with a hand frother, or shake it in a closed jar with a cloth over it.
Pour the milk into the coffee, spoon the foam on top, and add sugar if you like.
hi: बड़े कप में कॉफ़ी को गरम पानी में घोलें (या बनी हुई कॉफ़ी डालें)।
दूध को गरम करें, उबालें नहीं।
हैंड फ्रॉदर से झाग बनाएं, या बंद जार में डालकर कपड़े से पकड़कर हिलाएं।
दूध कॉफ़ी में डालें, ऊपर झाग रखें और चाहें तो चीनी मिलाएं।

name: Black Coffee
highlights: Just coffee and hot water: bold, simple and no milk
Almost no calories when you skip the sugar
Add a squeeze of lemon or a pinch of cinnamon for a twist
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.
Strong on an empty stomach for some people; have it after a light snack if it upsets you.

ingredients.en: 1 tsp instant coffee or 2 tbsp ground coffee
ingredients.hi: 1 छोटा चम्मच इंस्टेंट कॉफ़ी या 2 बड़े चम्मच पिसी कॉफ़ी
स्वाद अनुसार चीनी या गुड़ (चाहें तो)

en: For instant coffee, stir it into the hot water.
For ground coffee, steep it in the hot water for 4 minutes, then strain.
Add sugar only if you need it. Serve hot.
hi: इंस्टेंट कॉफ़ी हो तो गरम पानी में घोल दें।
पिसी कॉफ़ी हो तो गरम पानी में 4 मिनट रखें, फिर छान लें।
ज़रूरत हो तभी चीनी डालें। गरम परोसें।

name: Café Mocha
highlights: Coffee and chocolate together in hot milk
Rich and sweet, like a coffee and a hot chocolate in one cup
Lovely on a cold winter evening with friends
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.
A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less sugar or skip the cream.

ingredients.hi: 1 बड़ा चम्मच कटी डार्क चॉकलेट (चाहें तो)

en: Mix coffee, cocoa and sugar with 2 tbsp hot water to a smooth paste.
Heat the milk with the chocolate, stirring till it melts.
Pour the hot milk over the paste and whisk till frothy. Serve hot.
hi: कॉफ़ी, कोको और चीनी को 2 बड़े चम्मच गरम पानी में मिलाकर चिकना पेस्ट बनाएं।
दूध में चॉकलेट डालकर गरम करें और पिघलने तक चलाएं।
गरम दूध पेस्ट पर डालें और झाग आने तक फेंटें। गरम परोसें।

name: Masala Coffee
highlights: Milky coffee warmed with elaichi, dalchini and a little black pepper
A desi twist on coffee for winter mornings and rainy days
The spices give a warm smell and taste with no extra sugar
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.

ingredients.en: 1 small piece cinnamon and 2 black peppercorns
ingredients.hi: दालचीनी का छोटा टुकड़ा और 2 काली मिर्च

en: Boil the water with cardamom, cinnamon and pepper for 2 minutes.
Add the milk and bring it to a boil.
Turn off the heat, stir in the coffee and sugar (add jaggery only now, off the heat, so the milk doesn't split).
Strain into cups and serve hot.
hi: पानी में इलायची, दालचीनी और काली मिर्च डालकर 2 मिनट उबालें।
दूध डालकर उबाल आने दें।
आंच बंद करके कॉफ़ी और चीनी मिलाएं (गुड़ हो तो आंच बंद करके ही डालें, ताकि दूध न फटे)।
छानकर कप में डालें और गरम परोसें।

name: Classic Cold Coffee
highlights: Thick, frothy and chilled: the café favourite, blended at home
Ready in 5 minutes with a mixer
Add a scoop of ice cream on top for a party version
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.
A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less sugar or skip the cream.

en: Dissolve the coffee and sugar in 2 tbsp warm water.
Put it in the mixer with the cold milk and ice.
Blend for a minute till very frothy.
Swirl chocolate syrup inside the glass, pour in the coffee and serve.
hi: कॉफ़ी और चीनी को 2 बड़े चम्मच गुनगुने पानी में घोलें।
इसे ठंडे दूध और बर्फ़ के साथ मिक्सी में डालें।
एक मिनट चलाएं, जब तक खूब झाग न आ जाए।
गिलास के अंदर चॉकलेट सिरप लगाएं, कॉफ़ी डालें और परोसें।

name: Dalgona Coffee
highlights: A cloud of whipped coffee on top of cold milk
Looks like a café drink and needs only three things
Stir the foam into the milk before you drink
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.
A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less sugar or skip the cream.

en: Put the coffee, sugar and hot water in a bowl.
Whisk for 4–5 minutes (or 2 minutes with a beater) till thick, light and holding peaks.
Fill a glass with ice and cold milk.
Spoon the whipped coffee on top and serve.
hi: कटोरे में कॉफ़ी, चीनी और गरम पानी डालें।
4–5 मिनट (बीटर से 2 मिनट) फेंटें, जब तक गाढ़ा और हल्का न हो जाए।
गिलास में बर्फ़ और ठंडा दूध डालें।
ऊपर फेंटी हुई कॉफ़ी रखें और परोसें।

name: Iced Latte
highlights: Strong coffee poured over ice and cold milk, not blended
Lighter than cold coffee, with pretty layers in the glass
Easy to make less sweet
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.

ingredients.en: 1½ tsp instant coffee or ¼ cup strong brewed coffee
ingredients.hi: 1½ छोटे चम्मच इंस्टेंट कॉफ़ी या ¼ कप तेज़ बनी कॉफ़ी
3 बड़े चम्मच पानी (इंस्टेंट कॉफ़ी के लिए)

en: Mix the coffee and sugar in the water (or use brewed coffee) and let it cool.
Fill a glass with ice and pour in the cold milk.
Slowly pour the coffee on top to make layers. Stir before drinking.
hi: कॉफ़ी और चीनी को पानी में घोलें (या बनी हुई कॉफ़ी लें) और ठंडा होने दें।
गिलास में बर्फ़ भरें और ठंडा दूध डालें।
ऊपर से धीरे-धीरे कॉफ़ी डालें ताकि परतें बनें। पीने से पहले मिला लें।

name: Affogato
highlights: A scoop of vanilla ice cream 'drowned' in hot coffee
Half dessert, half coffee: eat it with a spoon
An easy, fancy end to a dinner party
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.
A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less sugar or skip the cream.
Use an eggless vanilla ice cream (look for the green dot).

ingredients.en: A few chopped nuts or grated chocolate
ingredients.hi: थोड़े कटे मेवे या कसी हुई चॉकलेट

en: Put the ice cream in a small glass or bowl.
Mix the coffee in the hot water to make a strong shot.
Pour the hot coffee over the ice cream, top with nuts or chocolate and serve at once.
hi: छोटे गिलास या कटोरी में आइसक्रीम रखें।
गरम पानी में कॉफ़ी घोलकर तेज़ कॉफ़ी बनाएं।
गरम कॉफ़ी आइसक्रीम पर डालें, ऊपर मेवे या चॉकलेट डालें और तुरंत परोसें।

name: Mocha Frappé
highlights: Icy blended coffee with chocolate, thick like a slush
Tastes like a café frappé, made in the mixer
Top with a little whipped cream for a party
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.
A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less sugar or skip the cream.

ingredients.en: 1 tbsp cocoa powder or chocolate syrup
ingredients.hi: 1 बड़ा चम्मच कोको पाउडर या चॉकलेट सिरप

en: Dissolve coffee, cocoa and sugar in 2 tbsp warm water.
Blend with the milk and plenty of ice till thick and slushy.
Pour into a tall glass and serve with a straw.
hi: कॉफ़ी, कोको और चीनी को 2 बड़े चम्मच गुनगुने पानी में घोलें।
दूध और खूब सारी बर्फ़ के साथ मिक्सी में गाढ़ा होने तक चलाएं।
लंबे गिलास में डालकर स्ट्रॉ के साथ परोसें।

name: Condensed Milk Iced Coffee
highlights: Strong coffee with sweet condensed milk over ice, Vietnamese style
Bold and very sweet: a small glass is enough
South Indian filter decoction works beautifully here
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.
A treat, not a health drink: condensed milk is very sweet. Use just a little.

ingredients.en: ¼ cup strong filter coffee decoction or 1½ tsp instant coffee in ¼ cup hot water
ingredients.hi: ¼ कप तेज़ फ़िल्टर कॉफ़ी डिकॉक्शन या ¼ कप गरम पानी में 1½ छोटे चम्मच इंस्टेंट कॉफ़ी

en: Put the condensed milk at the bottom of a glass.
Pour the hot coffee over it and stir well.
Fill with ice, add cold milk if you like it lighter, and serve.
hi: गिलास के नीचे कंडेंस्ड मिल्क डालें।
ऊपर से गरम कॉफ़ी डालकर अच्छी तरह मिलाएं।
बर्फ़ भरें, हल्की चाहिए तो ठंडा दूध डालें और परोसें।

name: Coconut Cold Coffee
highlights: Cold coffee made with coconut milk instead of dairy
Creamy, with a gentle coconut taste
A good pick for anyone who avoids cow's milk
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of coffee has about 50–120 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all, roughly 2–3 cups of coffee. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.
Coconut milk is rich; use the thinner kind or mix it half and half with water.

ingredients.hi: 2 छोटे चम्मच चीनी या गुड़ पाउडर

en: Dissolve the coffee and sugar in 2 tbsp warm water.
Blend with the coconut milk and ice till frothy.
Pour into a glass and serve cold.
hi: कॉफ़ी और चीनी को 2 बड़े चम्मच गुनगुने पानी में घोलें।
नारियल के दूध और बर्फ़ के साथ झागदार होने तक मिक्सी में चलाएं।
गिलास में डालकर ठंडा परोसें।

name: Masala Chai
highlights: The everyday Indian chai: tea leaves boiled with milk, ginger and elaichi
Strong, sweet and spicy, best with a light snack
Boil it well for that deep colour
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of tea has about 30–65 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.

en: Boil the water with ginger and cardamom for 1 minute.
Add the tea leaves and sugar and boil for 1 more minute.
Add the milk and let it come to a boil 2–3 times on medium heat.
Strain into cups and serve hot.
hi: पानी में अदरक और इलायची डालकर 1 मिनट उबालें।
चाय पत्ती और चीनी डालकर 1 मिनट और उबालें।
दूध डालें और मध्यम आंच पर 2–3 उबाल आने दें।
छानकर कप में डालें और गरम परोसें।

name: Kashmiri Kahwa
highlights: Golden green tea with saffron, elaichi, dalchini and sliced almonds
Light, fragrant and no milk
Served in Kashmir to guests on cold days
caution: Green tea has a little caffeine, less than black tea or coffee.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.

ingredients.en: 2 green cardamom and 1 small piece cinnamon
ingredients.hi: 2 हरी इलायची और दालचीनी का छोटा टुकड़ा

en: Boil the water with cardamom, cinnamon and saffron for 3 minutes.
Turn off the heat, add the green tea, cover and leave for 2 minutes (not longer, or it turns bitter).
Strain, stir in sugar, and top each cup with sliced almonds.
hi: पानी में इलायची, दालचीनी और केसर डालकर 3 मिनट उबालें।
आंच बंद करके ग्रीन टी डालें, ढककर 2 मिनट रखें (ज़्यादा देर नहीं, वरना कड़वा हो जाएगा)।
छानें, चीनी मिलाएं और हर कप में ऊपर से कटे बादाम डालें।

name: Irani Chai
highlights: Hyderabad's creamy tea: strong brew mixed with thick, sweet milk
Rich and smooth, made for Osmania biscuits or bun maska
The tea is brewed slowly on a low flame
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of tea has about 30–65 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.
A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less sugar or skip the cream.

ingredients.hi: 2 बड़े चम्मच कंडेंस्ड मिल्क या खोया

en: Boil the water with tea leaves and cardamom, then cover and simmer on low for 10 minutes.
In another pan, boil the milk with condensed milk on low for 8–10 minutes till a little thick.
Pour half a cup of the strained tea into each cup, then top up with the thick milk.
Add sugar if needed, stir and serve.
hi: पानी में चाय पत्ती और इलायची डालकर उबालें, फिर ढककर धीमी आंच पर 10 मिनट पकाएं।
दूसरे बर्तन में दूध और कंडेंस्ड मिल्क को धीमी आंच पर 8–10 मिनट थोड़ा गाढ़ा होने तक उबालें।
हर कप में आधा कप छनी चाय डालें, फिर ऊपर से गाढ़ा दूध भरें।
ज़रूरत हो तो चीनी डालें, मिलाएं और परोसें।

name: Lemon Iced Tea
highlights: Chilled black tea with lemon and mint, no milk
Lighter than cold coffee, with less caffeine
Make a jug ahead and keep it in the fridge
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of tea has about 30–65 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.
Sweet bottled iced teas have a lot of sugar; home-made lets you use just a little.

ingredients.en: 2 tsp tea leaves or 2 tea bags
ingredients.hi: 2 छोटे चम्मच चाय पत्ती या 2 टी बैग

ingredients.en: A few mint leaves and ice
ingredients.hi: कुछ पुदीने के पत्ते और बर्फ़

en: Boil the water, turn off the heat, add the tea and leave for 3 minutes. Strain.
Stir in the sugar and let it cool.
Add lemon juice and mint.
Pour over ice and serve with a lemon slice.
hi: पानी उबालें, आंच बंद करके चाय डालें और 3 मिनट रखें। छान लें।
चीनी मिलाकर ठंडा होने दें।
नींबू का रस और पुदीना डालें।
बर्फ़ पर डालें और नींबू के टुकड़े के साथ परोसें।

name: Gud Wali Chai
highlights: Milky chai sweetened with jaggery instead of sugar
A deep, caramel-like taste that tastes of winter
Add the jaggery last, off the heat, so the milk doesn't split
caution: Has caffeine (a cup of tea has about 30–65 mg). Adults: keep to about 300 mg of caffeine a day in all. Pregnant women: no more than 200 mg a day.
Have it at least an hour before or after a meal: tea and coffee with food stop the body taking up iron.
Not for young children. Skip it in the evening if it keeps you awake.
Jaggery is still sugar; use the same small amount you would of sugar.

en: Boil the water with ginger and tea leaves for 2 minutes.
Add the milk and boil 2–3 times.
Turn off the heat, wait 30 seconds, then stir in the jaggery till it melts.
Strain and serve hot.
hi: पानी में अदरक और चाय पत्ती डालकर 2 मिनट उबालें।
दूध डालकर 2–3 उबाल आने दें।
आंच बंद करें, 30 सेकंड रुकें, फिर गुड़ डालकर घुलने तक मिलाएं।
छानकर गरम परोसें।

name: Hot Chocolate
highlights: Thick, velvety chocolate in hot milk
A cosy winter treat the kids will love too
Real cocoa and a little dark chocolate, no ready-mix needed
caution: Cocoa has a little caffeine, much less than coffee.
A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less sugar or skip the cream.
Fine for children now and then, in a small cup.

en: Mix cocoa and sugar with 2 tbsp of the milk to a smooth paste.
Heat the rest of the milk, add the paste and chocolate, and stir till melted.
Simmer for 2 minutes till a little thick, whisk till frothy and serve hot.
hi: कोको और चीनी को 2 बड़े चम्मच दूध में मिलाकर चिकना पेस्ट बनाएं।
बाकी दूध गरम करें, पेस्ट और चॉकलेट डालें और पिघलने तक चलाएं।
2 मिनट हल्का गाढ़ा होने तक पकाएं, झाग आने तक फेंटें और गरम परोसें।

name: Cold Cocoa
highlights: Thick chilled chocolate milk, the old-school café favourite
A coffee-free pick for kids and teens
Blend in a scoop of ice cream to make it a shake
caution: Cocoa has a little caffeine, much less than coffee.
A treat, not a health drink: it has added sugar. Use less sugar or skip the cream.

en: Mix the cocoa and sugar in 2 tbsp warm milk till smooth.
Blend with the cold milk and ice till frothy.
Swirl chocolate syrup in the glass, pour in the cocoa and serve.
hi: कोको और चीनी को 2 बड़े चम्मच गुनगुने दूध में चिकना होने तक मिलाएं।
ठंडे दूध और बर्फ़ के साथ झागदार होने तक मिक्सी में चलाएं।
गिलास में चॉकलेट सिरप लगाएं, कोको डालें और परोसें।
